specification.problem: Simulate an abstract-model circuit (arbitrary pairwise interactions) on a nearest-neighbor kD grid (k>=2) with a classical controller, using Bell-pair routing, entanglement swapping, gate teleportation and Pauli-frame feed-forward, so depth stays O(d). Scoped target: a tiny measurement-free unitary instance of the core primitive, long-range CNOT between two logical qubits at distance 2 on a 1D line segment of a grid, via a Bell pair created by local gates and entanglement swapping, with the measurement corrections deferred as coherent controlled Paulis.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Only the long-range CNOT on 5 qubits (control c, target t, with an intermediate chain) is specified, as a deferred-measurement unitary with nearest-neighbor gates only. Not covered: general routing on Z^k, congestion handling, Shor's algorithm, fanout and controlled-operation constant-depth constructions, non-adaptive Theta(k-th root of n) circuits, lower bounds.

symbols.meaning: logical control and target qubits at the two ends of the line
ancilla qubits on the path between c and t

equations.label: Depth equivalence
equations.description: Grid circuits with classical control match abstract-model depth up to a constant factor.
equations.abstract_quote: is the same (up to a constant factor) as in the standard model where arbitrary interactions are allowed
equations.justification: Directly states the claimed depth equivalence; the form of the equation is my rewriting.

equations.label: Bell pair
equations.description: Local EPR pair preparation used for routing.

equations.label: Entanglement swapping with Pauli byproduct
equations.latex: (\text{Bell meas. on }a_2a_3\text{ of }|\Phi^+\rangle_{a_1a_2}|\Phi^+\rangle_{a_3a_4})\Rightarrow |\Phi^+\rangle_{a_1a_4}\text{ up to }X^{m_1}Z^{m_2}\text{ on }a_4
equations.description: Fusing local Bell pairs into a long-range pair; byproduct is a Pauli determined by XOR of outcomes along path.
equations.justification: Standard teleportation/swapping identity; the parity combination across a path is from the method plan.
assumptions: Byproducts commute through to a Pauli frame

equations.label: Gate teleportation of CNOT via EPR pair (deferred measurement)
equations.latex: \mathrm{CNOT}_{c\to t}=\big(Z_t^{m_2}X_c^{m_1}\text{-type corrections}\big)\cdot\text{(local CNOTs and Bell-basis rotations on }c,a_1,a_4,t\text{)}
equations.description: Remote CNOT consuming a long-range EPR pair, with measurements replaced by coherent controlled Paulis so the circuit is a unitary.
equations.justification: Proposed concrete realization of the plan's step 4; correction details for the instance must be derived by the builder and verified against CNOT on the data qubits.

registers.name: data
registers.role: logical control c and target t at line ends

registers.name: anc
registers.role: path ancillas for Bell pair routing and swapping, and corrections

specification.initial_state: data in arbitrary input state; ancillas in |0>

steps.description: Create local Bell pairs on adjacent ancilla pairs along the path.
Fuse them by Bell-basis rotations (CNOT, H) and coherent controlled Pauli corrections to get a long-range EPR pair.
Teleport CNOT from c to t using the EPR pair, with deferred controlled Pauli corrections; ancillas end disentangled up to measurement-equivalent state.
Scale: parallelize across all disjoint pairs per layer (out of scoped build).

specification.classical_postprocessing: In the full method, the controller computes Pauli corrections as XOR of outcomes and plans routes; in the scoped build these are coherent controls.
assumptions: Instance chosen by me: long-range CNOT on a 1D segment
Measurements deferred into controlled gates to produce a measurement-free unitary
Exact ancilla count and layout left to builder
missing_information: Exact constant-depth constructions for fanout, controlled operations, Shor
Full details of adaptive corrections for non-Clifford gates
